answer: Attestation is a sealed bid. A peer hashes its call with a private salt, publishes it, and stakes 200 POA; the reveal opens only after the commit window shuts, so nobody reads a neighbor first. Each reveal is checked against its hash and the final verdict; a score more than one point off slashes the bond. A farm stamping "strong" on fifty clones sees nearly all 250 attestations diverge from the low grades those weak answers earn, so about 50,000 POA burns; an honest peer reading five answers loses nothing. Cedar dropped in the ocean never becomes timber; fifty wet logs stay driftwood.
